Baroi, Advocate 02/ 08.10.2025:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the O.P. No.2.
2.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 188/2024,
registered under sections 498A, 323 of I.P.C, pending in the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Ghatshila.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Ghatshila
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner happens to be husband of complainant and there is general and omnibus allegation of demand of dowry and torture.
He then submits that even false allegation of Witch Craft (Practice) Act has also been made however, the learned court has been pleased not to take cognizance under the said Act.
On these grounds, he submits that the petitioners may kindly be provided privilege of anticipatory bail.
4. Learned counsels for the State and O.P. No.2 oppose the prayer and submit that petitioner is the husband of the complainant and in view of that anticipatory bail may not be granted.

sentences.text: Considering that complainant has filed the complaint case alleging therein of demand of dowry and torture and prima facie it appears that there is general and omnibus allegation and the petitioner happens to the husband of the complainant and in that view of the matter, the petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned court within two weeks from today and the learned court shall release the petitioner on terms and conditions and sureties as learned court deems fit and proper.
6. This anticipatory bail application is disposed of.
